## What you will be able to do

::: {.landing-cards}
::: {.landing-card}
<span class="landing-card-number">01</span>

### Frame the problem

State the decision, the inputs, the constraints, and what would count as a correct answer before touching data.
:::
::: {.landing-card}
<span class="landing-card-number">02</span>

### Trace before you run

Follow an algorithm step by step on paper so that surprises in code become questions you can answer.
:::
:::

::: {.landing-promise}
Every result in this course comes with the evidence that supports it and the assumptions that limit it.
:::

## How a week works

::: {.landing-process}
<p><span>Read</span> <b>→</b> <span>Trace</span> <b>→</b> <span>Practise</span> <b>→</b> <span>Check</span> <b>→</b> <span>Reflect</span></p>
:::

::: {.landing-steps}
::: {.landing-step}
<span>Monday</span>

### Launch

Meet the problem of the week and make a first attempt.
:::
::: {.landing-step}
<span>Midweek</span>

### Study

Work through readings and short checks at your own pace.
:::
::: {.landing-step}
<span>Friday</span>

### Consolidate

Solve a paper exercise and discuss the difficult cases.
:::
:::
